summary: Verified Header responsiveness bug fix (breakpoint alignment). Both desktop nav ('hidden xl:flex' at line 74) and mobile menu button ('xl:hidden' at line 140) now align at the xl (1280px) Tailwind breakpoint. Tested 6 viewports and both dropdown hovers via Playwright on preview URL. All 8 acceptance criteria pass. Bug is FIXED — no more 1024-1279 dead-zone where either both or neither nav renders.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx breakpoints consistent: desktop nav xl:flex + mobile xl:hidden pair-matched at 1280px.
At 1280px viewport, donate button right edge is 1227px — 53px of safe margin, no overflow.
16px gap maintained between logo group and first nav item at both 1280 and 1440 — no overlap.

Dropdowns have proper data-testid attributes (nav-dropdown-about, nav-dropdown-resource-directory) and their menus (nav-dropdown-menu-*) render on hover via mouseenter/mouseleave with 180ms close delay.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header regression is fully resolved. Both breakpoints aligned at xl (1280px). Verified at 1440, 1280, 1200, 1024, 768, 375. Dropdown hovers work at 1440.
